snippet.title: Kapka The Game Short Gameplay
snippet.description:
Welcome to KAPKA The Game! 🎲✨

Take a first look at KAPKA The Game in this short gameplay showcase!

In this video, you’ll see the main menu, multiplayer lobby, another player joining the game, a short gameplay session, and a quick look at the in-game shop.

KAPKA The Game is a colorful multiplayer board game experience filled with unpredictable events, items, competition and plenty of chaos. Every match can play out differently!

This is only a small glimpse of what KAPKA The Game has to offer — more features, gameplay and updates are coming.

🎮 In this video:

Main Menu
Multiplayer Lobby
Player Joining
Short Gameplay
In-Game Shop
